name: WCTE
summary: WCTE was a CERN charged-particle test-beam experiment validating water-Cherenkov reconstruction and multi-PMT technology for Hyper-Kamiokande and its Intermediate Water Cherenkov Detector. The principal beam campaign is complete and the collaboration is analysing the data.
physics_targets: Hadronic interactions and neutron production relevant to neutrino experiments
detection_principle: Identified low-momentum charged particles enter a water tank instrumented with multi-PMT modules. Their measured beam momentum and species calibrate Cherenkov-light response, reconstruction and secondary-neutron production relevant to neutrino-water events.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: The 2026 collaboration report states that the beam campaign ran from October 2024 to June 2025. The CERN Greybook lists Data Analysis; its administrative transition date of 25 August 2025 is not the physical beam-run end date.

timeline.event: CERN Greybook administrative status changed to Data Analysis.

collaboration.name: WCTE Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: Water tank
key_parameters.value: 40-tonne water capacity, approximately 4 m diameter and height

key_parameters.name: Photon detection
key_parameters.value: 97 multi-PMT modules; each module contains nineteen 3-inch PMTs

key_parameters.name: Test-beam momentum range
key_parameters.value: Approximately 200-1000 MeV/c for pions, muons, electrons and protons

results.summary: Reported the assembly, optical testing and installation of multi-PMT modules.
Presented detector performance, beam monitoring and the data-analysis programme after the completed beam campaign.

science_scope: WCTE receives charged particles rather than a neutrino beam. It is included as a named neutrino-detector calibration experiment, consistent with the archive treatment of ENUBET, DsTau and LArIAT.
